perks.name: Primary Survivor
perks.description: When an ally is defeated, Primary ammo weapons gain increased handling, reload speed, target acquisition, and reduced flinch. Bonus increases when multiple allies are dead at the same time or when you are running solo.
perks.exact:

Primary Survivor x2 | Primary Weapons are granted +? Handling, +? Reload Speed, +? Aim Assist, and ?% Flinch Resist.

perks.name: Primary Phantom
perks.description: Final blows with Primary ammo weapons remove you from radar for a short time. Drawing a weapon that does not use Primary ammo will immediately end this effect.
perks.exact:
On Primary Kill:
Prevents passively pinging enemy radar for 7 seconds.
Readying a Special or Power Weapon will remove the buff.
